_comment: What the CurseForge pack is called and versioned. tools/build-curseforge-pack.py reads this, the launcher's own record of the Ascension Dev instance (every tracked mod by project and file id), pack/curseforge-extras.json (the mods placed by hand), the built ascension_*.jar files and pack/config.

leave_out_of_the_manifest.shaderpacks: Shaders are not supported in space yet (clouds drawn in space, planets with toothed edges) and Create Aeronautics warns of Iris problems, so the alpha ships Iris but no shader pack; a player can add one.
